profile_text.body:
Perplexity is a for-profit startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. On its own website the company describes Perplexity as a free AI-powered answer engine that provides accurate, trusted, and real-time answers to any question.

The company's tracked products are Perplexity AI, described as a search-augmented LLM, and Perplexity Enterprise Pro, an enterprise search product whose listed features include internal knowledge search, data indexing, SSO, and audit logs. Two MCP servers are also listed: ai.perplexity/mcp-server, described as real-time web search, reasoning, and research through Perplexity's API, and ai.smithery/arjunkmrm-perplexity-search, which lets AI assistants perform web searches using Perplexity's Sonar Pro.

Perplexity is named as a defendant in a number of court cases. These include Gagleard v. Perplexity AI, Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California and in the District Court, E.D. California; Cable News Network Inc v. Perplexity AI, Inc., The New York Times Company v. Perplexity AI, Inc., Chicago Tribune Company, LLC v. Perplexity AI, Inc., and Encyclopaedia Britannica, Inc. v. Perplexity AI, Inc., all in the District Court, S.D. New York; Noel v. Perplexity AI, Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California; Amazon.com Services LLC v. Perplexity AI, Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California; and Amazon.com Services, LLC v. Perplexity AI, Inc. before the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit.
